author: homeless_potato43
body:
Only changes would be if you're having difficulty in certain areas. If you have trouble surviving I'd swap the augments the the axe to prom/selene feet. Maybe try for arisen shield over what you currently have. Alternatively if you are fine with survival but fights take too long look at using some summon stat gear

Biggest improvement would be an old nothren crown.

I think usually AHydra is considered better than phaeton but it's not that big of a deal. Like the other comment said mimic isn't really needed and wisp 2 is really good. 

For the most part GSA usually just wants to be bulky and buff def/res and can ignore the jinn/bear talent (exception would be endless runs). I'm currently running a yelm gown as my chest bc I don't really have to worry about dying.

It's kinda hard to say what improvements can be made without knowing what exotic gear you have available either
